standard_prerequisites.name: The description of pi^{-1}
standard_prerequisites.statement: pi_X^{-1}F is computed on an object X' of the big etale site by Gamma(X'_etale, (g_{small})^{-1}F), and similarly for pi_Y (the author's lemma-describe-pullback, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It gives the second equality of part (1) and the second displayed equality at source lines 1046 and 1052.

standard_prerequisites.name: Proper base change for sheaves and complexes
standard_prerequisites.statement: The proper base change isomorphism for sheaves of sets and the base change theorem for complexes with torsion cohomology sheaves (the author's lemma-proper-base-change-f-star and lemma-proper-base-change, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: They finish parts (1) and (2) at source lines 1053-1055 and 1086-1088.

standard_prerequisites.name: The comparison of underived and derived pushforwards
standard_prerequisites.statement: The comparison between f_{small,*} and f_{big,*} and its parts (1) and (3) for the base changed morphism (the author's lemma-compare-higher-direct-image, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It rewrites the pullback of the base change map at source lines 1083-1085 and gives the exactness of f_{big,*} at source lines 1095-1097.

standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of the direct image for a finite morphism
standard_prerequisites.statement: For f finite the functor f_{small,*} is exact, hence its higher direct images vanish (Cohomology of Spaces, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the first step of part (3) at source lines 1091-1094.

standard_prerequisites.name: The canonical base change map
standard_prerequisites.statement: The canonical map pi_X^{-1}Rf_{small,*}K -> Rf_{big,*}pi_Y^{-1}K whose being an isomorphism is the content of part (2) (Cohomology on Sites, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the map studied in part (2) at source lines 1063-1066.

core_obligations: Part (1): evaluate (f_{big,*}pi_Y^{-1}F)(X') and (pi_X^{-1}f_{small,*}F)(X') on the fibre product, identify both with f'_{small,*}(g'_{small})^{-1}F, and apply proper base change for sheaves of sets with compatibility of restriction maps (source lines 1029-1060).

Part (2): start from the canonical base change map, reduce to checking that its pullback along every object of the small etale site of X is an isomorphism, rewrite that pullback via the comparison lemma for the underived pushforward, and apply proper base change for K bounded below with torsion cohomology sheaves (source lines 1062-1088).
Part (3): for finite f use the exactness of f_{small,*}, deduce the exactness of f_{big,*} from the comparison lemma and its part (3), and conclude from part (1) (source lines 1090-1098).

proof_roadmap.step: Part (1) by a fibre-product computation, the description of pi^{-1} and proper base change for sheaves of sets.
Part (2) by pulling the canonical base change map back along the small etale site and applying proper base change.
Part (3) from the exactness of the direct images for finite morphisms plus part (1).

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-compare-higher-direct-image-proper at source lines 1014-1027: for a proper f : Y -> X of algebraic spaces the functor identity pi_X^{-1} o f_{small,*} = f_{big,*} o pi_Y^{-1} holds, its derived form pi_X^{-1}Rf_{small,*}K = Rf_{big,*}pi_Y^{-1}K holds for K in D^+(Y_etale) with torsion cohomology sheaves, and the derived form holds for all K in D(Y_etale) when f is finite. The author's proof at source lines 1029-1099 proves (1) by evaluating both sides at an object X' of the big etale site over the fibre product, identifying the two descriptions on Y' with the author's description of the pullback, and concluding with proper base change for sheaves of sets; proves (2) by reducing the base change map to its pullback along every object of the small etale site of X, rewriting the pullback using the author's comparison lemma for the underived pushforward, and applying the proper base change theorem to the resulting map; and proves (3) by the exactness of f_{small,*} for finite f (a cross-chapter pointer), the exactness of f_{big,*} from the same-chapter comparison lemma and part (3) of it, and part (1). Four results of the same chapter are retained as context so that every reference resolves inside the package; two cross-chapter results are declared as tagged pointers.
